record_status: OVERWRITTEN -- this is not a machine-collected record
what_happened: reproduce.py stamped provenance before it decided whether it had been asked to run or only to verify, and repro_20260827 was the default --outroot. A later `reproduce.py --verify`, which re-diffs files already on disk and produces no new numbers, therefore replaced this directory's record with its own. The original machine record of the 2026-08-27 pass is lost: it was never committed, so it cannot be restored from version control.
fixed_in_code: reproduce.py now stamps only on the branch that writes files, and provenance.stamp() refuses to replace an existing record unless called with replace=True.

recovered_from_document.note: These values are transcribed from REPRODUCE.md, which recorded the pass in prose at the time. They are a written account, not a machine stamp, and are labelled as such so that nothing here can be mistaken for collected evidence.

overwriting_event.note: What the destroyed record was replaced by. Kept so the loss is auditable rather than silent.
overwriting_event.what_it_did: Re-diffed the CSVs already in this directory against the archive. It ran no experiment and produced no number, so the results here remain the GPU output of 2026-08-27; only the record of them was replaced.

reproduce_summary_json: Also written by the verify run above, and therefore carries its return codes rather than the original pass's. The diff outcome it reports is over the same files either way.
